_docs: Scheduled headless agent jobs. Read by LIFEOS/TOOLS/AgentJob.ts loadJobs() — jobs[] must be a NON-EMPTY array; each job needs a kebab-case id, a unique id, and EXACTLY ONE of `command` (argv array, run as a script) or `prompt` (run as a headless DA session). `preScript` is only allowed with `prompt` (its last stdout line `{"wakeAgent": false}` skips the agent run). `schedule` is `every <N>m` or a 5-field cron limited to `M H * * DOW` (InstallAgentJobs.ts refuses anything else). Install with `bun LIFEOS/TOOLS/InstallAgentJobs.ts`; jobs with enabled:false are skipped there and by `AgentJob.ts run` unless --force. The example jobs below are disabled — edit them or replace them with your own. Optional keys: `allowedTools` (headless tool allowlist string), `effort` (low|medium|high|xhigh), `timeoutMs`, `env` (string values; the tokens STATE and HOME wrapped in double curly braces expand to the job state dir and your home), and `deliver` ({kind:"imessage", to:"+E.164 number", sendCommand:[argv]} — the recipient and the result text are appended to sendCommand; omit it and let the job send through the communication skill instead). Quiet hours come from heartbeat.json.

jobs.title: Example script job
jobs.purpose: Runs a deterministic script on a schedule (no agent, no model call)

jobs.title: Example agent job
jobs.purpose: Runs a headless DA prompt every weekday morning, gated by a pre-script wake check
jobs.prompt: Summarize anything actionable from the pre-script findings included above. If nothing is actionable, output exactly [SILENT].

jobs.title: Achilles nightly fix-preparer
jobs.purpose: Prepares fixes for up to 3 open agent-class Achilles entries (LIFEOS/TOOLS/AchillesRemediate.ts); enable once Achilles has entries
